name: skylark_change_seat
intent: Change the seat for a SkyLark flight
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark, selects the flight to the requested city, opens seat selection, chooses the requested seat, and confirms the seat change.
patterns: change my seat on my flight
change my seat to a different seat
move me to another seat on my trip
change my seat on my flight to a new seat

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The destination city of the flight whose seat is to be changed.

inputs.name: desired_seat
inputs.description: The new seat to select for the flight.

steps.intent: Open My Trips to find the flight
Open seat selection to change the seat
